source_text: Hanc legem etiam novi testamenti discipuli aliquatenus observare convenit; sunt mandata litterae quae cum spiritu servantur. Eleemosyna et oblatio pauperum sacerdotium Christi honorant.
pass_a_gloss: This law even of-new testament disciples somewhat to-observe is-fitting; there-are commands of-letter which with spirit are-kept. Alms and offering of-poor priesthood of-Christ honor.
pass_b_english: Disciples of the new covenant do well to keep this law in due measure; some commands of the letter are kept with the Spirit. Alms and gifts for the poor honor Christ’s priesthood.
